import cv2
import numpy as np
import json
import math

with open('/work/poses.json') as f:
    poses = json.load(f)

# Triangulation / ray intersection:
def get_ray(frame_id, u, v=None):
    pose = poses[str(frame_id)]
    h_rad = math.radians(pose['h'])
    alpha = math.atan2(u - 255.5, 256.0)
    theta = h_rad + alpha
    dx = math.sin(theta)
    dy = math.cos(theta)
    return np.array([pose['x'], pose['y']]), np.array([dx, dy])

def intersect_multiple_rays(rays):
    # rays: list of (origin, dir)
    # Solve least squares point minimizing distance to all rays
    # For each ray i: (I - d_i d_i^T) (p - o_i) = 0
    A = np.zeros((2, 2))
    b = np.zeros(2)
    for o, d in rays:
        d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
        proj = np.eye(2) - np.outer(d, d)
        A += proj
        b += proj @ o
    p = np.linalg.solve(A, b)
    return p

# 1. Floor Lamp:
# Base center observed in frames 2, 12, 18, 20, 30, 37, 38
# Let's detect base / cone center in these frames
lamp_frames = [2, 12, 18, 20, 30, 37, 38]
lamp_rays = []
for f in lamp_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    # yellow cone
    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, (15, 30, 80), (35, 255, 255))
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 20:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        lamp_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Lamp in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_lamp = intersect_multiple_rays(lamp_rays)
print(f"Optimized Floor Lamp: x={p_lamp[0]:.3f}, y={p_lamp[1]:.3f}")

# 2. Chair 2 (foreground/east chair):
# Observed in 1, 8, 19, 20, 27, 28, 29, 30, 37
chair2_frames = [1, 8, 19, 20, 28, 29, 30, 37]
chair2_rays = []
for f in chair2_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    # brown chair
    mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
           (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
           (img[:, :, 0] < 60)
    # In frame 37, chair 2 is right in front (center of screen)
    if f == 37:
        mask[:, :150] = 0
        mask[:, 400:] = 0
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        chair2_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Chair 2 in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_chair2 = intersect_multiple_rays(chair2_rays)
print(f"Optimized Chair 2: x={p_chair2[0]:.3f}, y={p_chair2[1]:.3f}")

# 3. Chair 1 (back-left chair):
# Observed in 1, 8, 14, 15, 22, 23, 24, 25, 33, 40
chair1_frames = [1, 8, 14, 15, 22, 24, 33, 40]
chair1_rays = []
for f in chair1_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
           (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
           (img[:, :, 0] < 60)
    # chair 1 is in back-left
    if f in [1, 8, 14]:
        mask[:, 200:] = 0
    elif f == 15:
        mask[:, 300:] = 0
    elif f in [33, 40]:
        mask[:, :200] = 0 # table is on the right/foreground, chair 1 is behind
        mask[:, 350:] = 0
    elif f == 24:
        # right in front
        pass
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        chair1_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Chair 1 in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_chair1 = intersect_multiple_rays(chair1_rays)
print(f"Optimized Chair 1: x={p_chair1[0]:.3f}, y={p_chair1[1]:.3f}")

# 4. Table:
# Observed in 1, 8, 14, 15, 19, 21, 22, 25, 33, 34, 40
table_frames = [1, 8, 14, 15, 21, 22, 25, 33, 40]

for f in table_frames:

    mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
           (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
           (img[:, :, 0] < 60)
    if f in [1, 8, 14]:
        mask[:, :170] = 0
        mask[:, 260:] = 0
    elif f == 15:
        mask[:, :300] = 0
    elif f in [33, 40]:
        # table is foreground
        mask[:, :250] = 0
    elif f == 25:
        # table on right
        mask[:, :250] = 0
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        table_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Table in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_table = intersect_multiple_rays(table_rays)
print(f"Optimized Table: x={p_table[0]:.3f}, y={p_table[1]:.3f}")

# 5. Sofa:
# Observed in 1, 14, 19, 20, 27, 28, 34, 35, 36
sofa_frames = [1, 14, 19, 28, 34, 35, 36]
sofa_rays = []
for f in sofa_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, (100, 20, 50), (130, 150, 200))
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        sofa_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Sofa in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_sofa = intersect_multiple_rays(sofa_rays)
print(f"Optimized Sofa: x={p_sofa[0]:.3f}, y={p_sofa[1]:.3f}")

# 6. Plant 1:
plant1_frames = [1, 7, 8, 15, 16, 23, 24, 33, 39, 40]
plant1_rays = []
for f in plant1_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, (35, 80, 40), (85, 255, 255))
    if f in [16, 39]:
        # Plant 1 is the one with larger x in 16, smaller x in 39
        if f == 16:
            mask[:, :100] = 0
        elif f == 39:
            mask[:, 300:] = 0
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        plant1_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Plant 1 in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_plant1 = intersect_multiple_rays(plant1_rays)
print(f"Optimized Plant 1: x={p_plant1[0]:.3f}, y={p_plant1[1]:.3f}")

# 7. Plant 2:
plant2_frames = [6, 16, 33, 39, 40]
plant2_rays = []
for f in plant2_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, (35, 80, 40), (85, 255, 255))
    if f in [16, 39]:
        if f == 16:
            mask[:, 100:] = 0
        elif f == 39:
            mask[:, :300] = 0
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        plant2_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Plant 2 in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_plant2 = intersect_multiple_rays(plant2_rays)
print(f"Optimized Plant 2: x={p_plant2[0]:.3f}, y={p_plant2[1]:.3f}")

# 8. Sideboard:
sideboard_frames = [18, 19, 20, 31, 38]
sideboard_rays = []
for f in sideboard_frames:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    # Cabinet top counter:
    counter_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 190) & (img[:, :, 0] < 235) & \
                   (img[:, :, 1] > 190) & (img[:, :, 1] < 235) & \
                   (img[:, :, 2] > 190) & (img[:, :, 2] < 235)
    ys, xs = np.where(counter_mask > 0)
    if len(xs) > 50:
        u = np.mean(xs)
        sideboard_rays.append(get_ray(f, u))
        print(f"Sideboard in frame {f}: u={u:.1f}")

p_sideboard = intersect_multiple_rays(sideboard_rays)
print(f"Optimized Sideboard: x={p_sideboard[0]:.3f}, y={p_sideboard[1]:.3f}")
